project.title: 第一笔大订单 · 社区书店
project.titleEn: The first large order · Community bookshop
project.brief: 店长带着一张画满箭头的纸来到孵化器：“能不能做得像那些大平台？”先选交付路线，再逐单澄清、派遣与验收。两条路线都通向路演，但需要的能力、现金回款和团队占用不同。
project.briefEn: The owner arrives with a page of arrows: “Can it work like the big platforms?” Choose a delivery route, then clarify, assign and accept each job. Both lead to a pitch, with different skills, payments and staffing commitments.

routes.label: 小范围系统
routes.description: 代码与推理为主；两期各26WP、基础报酬1550。需要复核边界，不承诺完整平台。
routes.descriptionEn: Code and reasoning; two phases of 26 WP at base pay 1550 each. Verify edge cases without promising a full platform.

steps.title: 大订单①：把“像大平台”写成验收单
steps.titleEn: Big order I: define what “like a platform” means

steps.title: 大订单②：预约系统，两次交付
steps.titleEn: Big order II: booking system in two deliveries

steps.title: 大订单③：带着真实账单去路演
steps.titleEn: Big order III: pitch with real delivery bills

routes.label: 服务手册先行
routes.description: 写作与知识为主；两期各22WP、基础报酬1350。先用现有表单解决服务问题。
routes.descriptionEn: Writing and knowledge; two phases of 22 WP at base pay 1350 each. Solve service problems with existing forms first.

steps.title: 大订单①：把“像大平台”写成验收单
steps.titleEn: Big order I: define what “like a platform” means

steps.title: 大订单②：先把店员手册交到手上
steps.titleEn: Big order II: the staff handbook comes first

steps.title: 大订单③：带着真实账单去路演
steps.titleEn: Big order III: pitch with real delivery bills

project.feedback: 店长带来了两期验收单和真实使用记录。回形针提醒：材料准备好了，路演前还要检查净资金和声望；完成后再决定搬家。
project.feedbackEn: The owner brings signed acceptances and usage records. Paperclip reminds you to check solvency and reputation before holding the pitch and moving on.
